required_observables: invalid start and negative count return NULL normally without source mutation
zero count copies the full remaining suffix
excessive count including INT_MAX clamps without overflow or hostile allocation
a partial result has head index zero and preserves later node/index relationships
valid complete copy and hidden full-path copy preserve the complete sequence
copy of SoTempPath returns a normally auditing SoPath
same per-configuration classification in forward and reverse order
representative behavior remains callable through frozen baseline headers
unknown_policy: Compile, link, archive, runner setup, or unavailable timeout support is Unknown and never passes. After a named operation starts, exception, signal, abort, memory-limit termination, timeout, unexpected pointer result, state mismatch, or audit mismatch is Violated. Only expected exit zero is Preserved.

read_allowlist: baseline public headers and baseline SoPath implementation

calibration_budget.stop_rule: Stop after two revisions with no classification gain, any further post-budget oracle defect, or the final order-invariance round.

limits: No future candidate implementation was inspected or modified.
No mutation score, seal, implementation verdict, or final certificate is claimed by this role.
